transcript.text: Hi everyone. Now that the workload-identity pilot completed successfully in staging, I need to put together the production rollout plan. As a reminder, the plan has to cover four areas: enforcement behavior, service handling, emergency access, and audit settings. Before I can publish it, I'll need to review with application platform engineering and compliance operations as part of the standard security sign-off. I'd like to start by hearing from each of you on what you know so we can build this out together.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While debugging an unrelated deployment this morning, I confirmed that the batch-ledger service still reads a static Kubernetes secret and will fail under enforcement. The migration is ready only if batch-ledger is excluded for exactly 14 days, and I haven't filed the compatibility note yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed with the audit team today that production enforcement must retain denied-token events for exactly 180 days, enable denied-token logging, and require two-person approval for every break-glass access. These requirements are not yet recorded in the rollout plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text:
Thanks both. Let me make sure I've captured everything correctly before we move forward.

Casey, so to confirm: batch-ledger still reads a static Kubernetes secret, will fail under enforcement, needs to be excluded for exactly 14 days, and the compatibility note hasn't been filed yet. I'll need that exclusion reflected in the plan. Can you commit to filing the compatibility note before we publish?

Morgan, from the audit team: denied-token logging must be enabled, denied-token events retained for exactly 180 days, and two-person approval required for every break-glass access. I'll make sure all three of those are written into the plan.

Before I draft the full plan for the security sign-off review with application platform engineering and compliance operations, is there anything else anyone needs to add regarding enforcement behavior, service handling, emergency access, or audit settings?
